remarks: Skyview is a superbly located condominium community in the West Norwalk area. This top-floor, two-bedroom unit features an open layout with recessed lighting, a fireplace, in-unit laundry, and a private walk-out balcony. The kitchen and bathroom have been newly renovated, and windows in every room invite in refreshing seasonal breezes.  Set in the rear of the complex, this unit offers a welcome sense of privacy. Daily conveniences are nearby with shopping and dining options just a short walk away. An attached garage with additional storage is located directly below. For commuters, access to I-95 is quick and convenient, and both S.Norwalk and Darien station are nearby. Prefer to not drive? A local bus line connects you to the trains, Stamford, and beyond. Added bonus, Norwalk Community College is just minutes away, ideal for students and faculty alike. NO PETS, NO SMOKING. Credit check, Proof of Income/Employment, Employment reference(s), Professional references. Area rugs in LR and BR, pls.
